page.layout: One page of running text. Margin notes run down the left margin (Tonitru., Fulgur., Chasma.). Catchword "CAPUT" at the lower right. Running head at the top centre, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: Tonitru.Fulminis adjuncta sunt Tonitru & Fulgur. Tonitru est sonus, quem ficca exhalatio, intra nubem magnam & den-sam conclusa, & ictu vehementi eam disrumpens, efficit. Fulgur.Fulgur seu coruscatio est flammae micatio, ab exhalationibus accensis & e nube erumpentibus exorta.
Fulmen porro Senecae triplex est, terebrans, discutiens (cum quo aliquando lapis seu telum fulmineum ex multis fuliginosis & conglutinatis exhalationibus coagulatum una ejicitur) et urens.

Apparens ignitum meteoron est Chasma.Chasma, quod speciem exhibet aperien-tis se & dehiscentis coeli, quando scili-cet exhalatio densa & viscosa, serena no-cte ad summam aeris oram evecta, in ex-tremis partibus, quae rariores sunt, in-flammatur, mediis vero densioribus non accensis; tunc enim propter album il-lum & luminosum partium extrema-rum, & nigrum seu caeruleum Medii colorem, coelum discedere videtur.

page.notes: Faint show-through and ghost text from the reverse side (for example a faint "Comet." mark beside the Tonitru lines and mirrored words in the lower half) left out. A small ornamental mark beside "Medii" in the left margin is not a note and is left out. A faint line at the bottom left and faint stains are left out. The word "Chasma" in the text and in the margin is printed in italic. Reading of the "Apparens" marker and the exact form of "no-cte" (ligature for "nocte") is slightly uncertain given the scan quality. The page number is read as 158 from the old-style figures at the top left.
